test.name: Locality guide for Oklahoma, 1889 — Land Run records
test.description: Checks if the skill recognizes the Land Run of 1889 and directs researchers to land allotment records, homestead applications, and territorial court files.

input.user_message: I’m researching ancestors in Oklahoma during the Land Run of 1889. What records or repositories would help trace families?

judge_context: Must mention the Land Run of 1889. Must highlight homestead applications, land allotments, and territorial court records. Must not suggest statewide vital registration for this period.

collection_read is served by a single generic mock fixture (collection-read-by-id) that always returns the same synthetic Pennsylvania Schuylkill County Church Records collection, regardless of the id argument passed — there is no Oklahoma-specific collection_read fixture. A collection_read call with a correct, plausible Oklahoma collection id (e.g. matching a collections_search/expected_args predicate) that gets back this unrelated Pennsylvania content is the fixture's known limitation, not a Tool Arguments error — do not penalize Tool Arguments for the mismatch between the requested id and the returned collection.
